text: A Psalm of Asaph. God{H430} standeth{H5324} in the congregation{H5712} of God;{H430} He judgeth{H8199} among{H7130} the gods.{H430}
How long will ye judge{H8199} unjustly,{H5766} And respect{H5375} the persons{H6440} of the wicked?{H7563} Selah{H5542}
Judge{H8199} the poor{H1800} and fatherless:{H3490} Do justice{H6663} to the afflicted{H6041} and destitute.{H7326}
Rescue{H6403} the poor{H1800} and needy:{H34} Deliver{H6403} them out of the hand{H3027} of the wicked.{H7563}
They know{H3045} not, neither do they understand;{H995} They walk{H1980} to and fro in darkness:{H2825} All the foundations{H4144} of the earth{H776} are shaken.{H4131}
I said,{H559} Ye are gods,{H430} And all of you sons{H1121} of the Most High.{H5945}
Nevertheless{H403} ye shall die{H4191} like men,{H120} And fall{H5307} like one{H259} of the princes.{H8269}
Arise,{H6965} O God,{H430} judge{H8199} the earth;{H776} For thou shalt inherit{H5157} all the nations.{H1471}
